description: Finite Element Micro-modeling of Unreinforced Earth Block Masonry is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "simulation", published or maintained by Michele Barbato, University of California Davis (ucdavis.edu). Earth block masonry (EBM) is attracting interest as an affordable and sustainable alternative to other mainstream materials and systems for low-rise buildings. However, most research on EBM focuses on its mechanical properties, not its structural behavior. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "simulation" project. Keywords: Finite Element Modeling, Earth Block Masonry, Simplified Micro-modeling, Detailed Micro-model. Published 2023-01-31. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
